name: Transparency
description: What postings actually disclose, per market. Mirrors v_field_completeness and Phase 3 #3.

cards.text:
## Transparency
**Source:** `v_field_completeness`, one row per market, never pooled.

**Mirrors:** Phase 3 #3 (docs/findings_field_completeness.md). Some columns measure our classifiers' reach, not what employers disclose: those are labelled instrument-limited. Data window: see the right.

cards.title: Data window
cards.description: First and last UTC snapshot date in the database and the n behind this dashboard (jobs per market).

cards.title: Salary: present vs employer-disclosed
cards.description: pct_salary_present counts any figure, including Adzuna's model estimate; pct_salary_disclosed counts employer-disclosed only. The gap between them is the headline.

cards.title: Fields that are market facts
cards.description: Completeness that reflects what postings contain. pct_skill_present is capped by commercial truncation (~500 characters).

cards.title: Instrument-limited fields (not market facts)
cards.description: All three are instrument-limited. pct_seniority_present: the classifier reads titles only. pct_metro_present: an allowlist lookup, so NULL means 'not tracked', not 'no location'. pct_remote_true: instrument-limited for federal (telework text lives in description_full, which the remote step doesn't read); a market fact for commercial.
